name: Alertmanager Matrix
description: Receive Alertmanager webhooks through a gateway-authenticated entry. Envoy Gateway validates basic auth, removes the Authorization header, and forwards only the x-alertmanager-user claim, so no credential material can enter execution data; a Code node enforces the claim before delivery. Execution data persistence is disabled because webhooks carry alert text; summary and description values are redacted of secret-shaped substrings before messaging.
